verdict.rationale: The GitHub README says PDFs and MS Office documents (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) can be POSTed directly via the `file` body field with no need to host them first. The docs also confirm native PDF support, and the prebuilt image bundles LibreOffice for Office conversion. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Office/PDF extraction, detail on extraction fidelity for Excel tables and PowerPoint slides, and documentation of the file-upload request format beyond a single line.
